description: Browse your Listen Labs studies, pull response data, review study designs, and surface analysis insights, all without leaving your workflow. Create, edit, and launch new user research studies directly from ChatGPT. Whether you're running market exploration, product discovery, usability testing, or testing hypotheses, Listen Labs becomes a native part of your research process: an AI-powered assistant that helps you synthesize qualitative findings faster, with deeper insight.
